pages.text: Disk or sample in, technology out

Put a tech disk, field sample or experiment record in the left slot and give the lab power (FE): a solar tracker next to it is enough for the first technologies. The analysis takes from 30 seconds to a few minutes.
The researcher is whoever opened the lab last. A disk is returned after reading, so you can lend it to friends; samples are used up. If a sample has nothing new for you, the lab says so and keeps it.
